basis: Otosclerosis affects the otic capsule and stapes, causing conductive hearing loss; no generalized skeletal disease.
Skeletal dysplasia defines this umbrella. Airway, cardiac and ocular damage vary across subtypes; involvement in at least 30% across the group is not established.
Squamous cell carcinoma in situ arising in the epidermis; the basement membrane remains intact.
Intracranial meningioma at the cerebellopontine angle; cranial nerve compression does not establish direct ear involvement.
Persistent localized epidermal keratinization disorder; no qualifying extracutaneous damage.
Developmental impairment and epilepsy define the disease. Hepatic dysfunction and cardiomyopathy occur in 1-4%; optic atrophy frequency is unspecified.
Isolated male infertility from abnormal sperm flagella and motility; reproductive dysfunction without established endocrine disease.
Intestinal atresia and profound combined immunodeficiency define the syndrome. Sparse hair and absent eyebrows do not establish damaging skin disease; other organ lesions are uncommon.
Congenital restriction of eye movements from the extraocular motor apparatus; no evidence of generalized skeletal muscle disease.
Heart and kidney defects are described as common, with rates unspecified. Cap excludes hearing loss and skeletal or palatal defects reported in 1/3 of small cohorts.
